usage_notice_text: The Harris County Elections Administrator's Office makes a diligent effort to post accurate information on this website, but assumes no liability for damages incurred directly or indirectly as a result of errors, omissions, or discrepancies. For additional information please review our Privacy Policy and our Accessibility Statement.
notes: Harris runs its own results app (harrisvotes.com Live Results iframes app.harrisvotes.com/electionresults/electionday). The app code loads appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/<electionCode>/resultsbyballot.json and, per contest, pv-<contestId>.json, rendered as a 'Precinct' voting tab, so the live site is built to show per-precinct numbers. But the files are overwritten in place: for the 2024 general (code 1124) resultsbyballot.json has dt 2024-11-15T17:30:00Z and Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:03:43 GMT; pv-7281.json (President) Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:03:22 GMT. No dated update history exists (check 1 not applicable; not Clarity). Data codes for the 2026 primary and runoff were not found (0326 and 0526 return 404) and were not guessed further. The Archives page lists only Official Cumulative and Official Canvass PDFs (e.g. 2024 general canvass file stamped 11-14-2024 03-12-57 PM); Election Reports lists reconciliation and audit forms, no election-night precinct reports. So no check could place precinct numbers on election night. The usage notice is the site footer on the Live Results page. Check 3 (wayback-data branch): the 2026 primary and runoff election-night captures of the county's own app (app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/RepublicanPrimary at 2026-03-03 20:01:30 CST; .../DemocraticPrimary at 2026-05-26 20:47:41 CDT) contain a 'Precinct Reporting' tab that loads per-precinct candidate votes (rep-pv-/dem-pv-<contestId>.json?nocache=<minute time>) from the same feed as the county totals, so both are LIVE under the live precinct view rule (confidence capped at med). No pv file itself was captured and the captured county-total files show only early and mail votes (ed all 0), so precinct_first_seen is left empty. The per-precinct pr.json files are ballots cast (turnout) and do not count. 2024 general stays UNDETERMINED: the app capture timed out and only the embedding www page and a county-totals file were saved. check 3 applied 2026-10-02 (agent check3-pilot).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both LIVE (check 3, live precinct view rule) and the 2024 general is UNDETERMINED, so two elections share LIVE and the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT; the live precinct view rule caps confidence at med.

2024_general.fact: Check 3 applied, not decided. 2024 election-night captures: www.harrisvotes.com/Election-Results/Live-Results at 2024-11-05 20:39:20 CST (file Harris/2024_general_20241106023920_24d4ff9e88d4.html; also 23:50:07 and 23:50:18 CST) only embeds the app: '<iframe src="https://app.harrisvotes.com/electionresults/electionday"></iframe>'. The app capture (20:39:21 CST) and pr.json capture timed out during the harvest. The saved resultsbyballot.json (20:39:22 CST, file Harris/2024_general_20241106023922_d0366eb3a7ab.json, dt 2024-11-06T01:10:00Z, vc 0 of 700) has county totals by contest only (ed all 0). The embedding page alone does not show the precinct view, so UNDETERMINED. Live app precinct file pv-7281.json today has Last-Modified Fri, 15 Nov 2024 18:03:22 GMT (post-canvass overwrite).

2026_primary.fact: Live precinct view rule. Wayback capture of the county's own results app app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/RepublicanPrimary at 2026-03-03 20:01:30 CST (file Harris/2026_primary_20260304020130_ad3eb5a4577a.html) has a per-contest tab '' filled by "$http.get('https://appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/' + electionCode + '/rep-pv-' + contestId + '.json?nocache=' + cacheTime)" and RenderPrecinctVoting, which builds a table with a 'Precinct' column, one column per candidate (contest[0].ca) and rows from vm.pv.v[key]; the county totals come from the same feed, "'/rep-resultsbyballot.json?nocache=' + cacheTime", with "var electionCode = '0326'; var cacheTime = (new Date(new Date().setSeconds(0, 0))).getTime();". The rep-pv files themselves were not captured; the captured rep-resultsbyballot.json (20:01:32 CST, dt 2026-03-04T01:03:00Z, vc 0 of 275) has county totals with ed all 0 (early and mail only), and rep-pr.json (20:01:33 CST) is per-precinct ballots cast (turnout), which does not count.

2026_runoff.fact: Live precinct view rule. Wayback capture of app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/DemocraticPrimary at 2026-05-26 20:47:41 CDT (file Harris/2026_runoff_20260527014741_a597a71f666b.html, var electionCode = '0526') has the same 'Precinct Reporting' tab (title="Precinct Reporting", #precinctVoting-{{ contest.i }}) loaded by "$http.get('https://appfiles.harrisvotes.com/harrisvotes/prd/Data/' + electionCode + '/dem-pv-' + contestId + '.json?nocache=' + cacheTime)" and rendered per candidate by RenderPrecinctVoting, from the same nocache feed as the county totals ('/dem-resultsbyballot.json?nocache=' + cacheTime). The captured dem-resultsbyballot.json (20:47:43 CDT, et 'Primary Runoff Elections', edt 'May 26, 2026', dt 2026-05-27T00:00:00Z, vc 0 of 157) has county totals with ed all 0; dem-pr.json (20:47:42 CDT) is per-precinct ballots cast only. No pv file was captured. Republican runoff app not captured; the www Republican-Primary-Election page (20:47:54 CDT) iframes app.harrisvotes.com/ElectionResults/RepublicanPrimary.
